inspection.reviewer: Codex direct inspection of before/after contact sheets and corrected full-size mobile panels
inspection.scope: Classic home, grouped mode picker, selected descriptions, Operations deck, run clocks, boss intro, Throne retake and mode victories; desktop 1440 and mobile390 in both themes.
findings: Original game was buried below Operations and labeled Normal; Classic Survival now has the first direct play card.
Desktop light-theme mode labels were pale; shared palette text now stays readable. Mobile has descriptions and category browsing.
Throne retake text clipped on mobile; screen-fitted announcement now shows the full message.
Boss overlay previously translated off center; new scale-only animation fills the viewport and respects reduced motion.
Score Attack countdown is visible above the arena; urgent two-second state rendered in red. Timed Survival restart resets to zero.
Boss terminal fixtures exposed a missing runtime helper; after repair all six actual boss spawns reached victory without wave seven.
fixesApplied: Shared mode picker and Classic entry
Accurate mode descriptions bound to mode facts
Clock visibility, per-run reset and tenths carry
Six solo boss progression and missing helper repair
Throne retake, mobile notice fitting and second-loss ending
Operation and Classic launch flag isolation

validation.security: zero npm vulnerabilities; release gate passed
limitations: Short natural-input checks do not establish completion or balance of every mode.
Controlled boss sequence boosts health and applies lethal damage; boundary fixtures set near-terminal state. These are not natural victories.
Physical controllers and participant feedback were not measured. Operation tests cover contracts and launch isolation, not all three natural campaign completions.
Existing survival-oriented debrief recommendations after objective victories remain a tracked improvement.
